{{Quote|It works! My very own lightsaber! Just like a real Jedi Knight!|Vima Sunrider|<ref name="R4" />}}
'''Vima Sunrider's lightsaber''' was a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] created in [[3986 BBY]] by the [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi apprentice]] [[Vima Sunrider]] during her [[Jedi training/Legends|tutelage]] under [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]]. Sunrider focused her lightsaber with [[Adegan crystal/Legends|Adegan crystals]] that once belonged to her late [[Parent/Legends|father]], [[Andur Sunrider]]. Upon its completion, the weapon produced a brilliant [[Color/Legends|green]] blade. She continued to use her newly-created lightsaber for the duration of her apprenticeship under Qel-Droma.

==Description==
{{Quote|These crystals were my father's.|Vima Sunrider, about the Adegan crystals used during her lightsaber's construction|<ref name="R4" />}}
The [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]] [[Vima Sunrider]] consisted of an assortment of metallic parts. When assembled, the lightsaber was multifaceted and segmented into three sections, the smallest at the base of the [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|hilt]]. Four protruding shrouds surrounded the [[Blade emitter/Legends|blade emitter]]. It was focused by a [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Adegan crystal/Legends|Adegan crystal]], which produced a blade of the same color upon activation. When not in use, the lightsaber was usually worn on Sunrider's hip.<ref name="R4" />

==History==
{{Quote|Although he was no longer capable of building a lightsaber, he instructed me to construct my own.|A recording made by Vima Sunrider via the Great Holocron|<ref name="JVS" />}}
[[File:BuildItVima-TOTJR04.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Vima Sunrider, pondering the pieces of her imminent lightsaber]]
In [[3986 BBY]], Vima Sunrider, apprentice to the reluctant self-[[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]] on the [[Water/Legends|ice]]-[[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rhen Var/Legends|Rhen Var]],<ref name="NEC" /> was presented with the final task of her [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]]: the creation of her own lightsaber. Sunrider sat before a table, on which all the necessary components for her project were laid. Also included were three green Adegan [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystals]], numbered among the cache once owned by her [[Death/Legends|late]] father, [[Andur Sunrider]]. Under guidance from Qel-Droma, Sunrider constructed her lightsaber, which she immediately activated upon completion. Much to her satisfaction, it operated without flaw and produced a bright green blade. The ignition of her weapon was met with the same gesture made by her Master, whom Sunrider then challenged to a practice [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]].<ref name="R4" />

Sunrider wielded her lightsaber in her first [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat]] lesson, during which she was taught to respect her weapon. She next put the lightsaber to use alongside Qel-Droma, as the pair carved gigantic ice sculptures into a frozen cliff face; Sunrider's of her father, and Qel-Droma's of his deceased and nonetheless beloved Jedi Master [[Arca Jeth]].<ref name="R4" />

By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of their second training bout, however, Sunrider had become reckless with her weapon, much to her Master's chagrin. A careless maneuver made, despite Qel-Droma's order to hold, resulted in the inadvertent severing of an extremely precious pendant worn round his neck. Vima soon afterward showed the lightsaber to her mother, famed [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Nomi Sunrider]], as a symbol of her excellence as an aspiring Jedi.<ref name="R5">[[Tales of the Jedi – Redemption 5|''Tales of the Jedi – Redemption'' 5]]</ref> [[3980 BBY|Six years]] later, via the [[Great Holocron/Legends|Great Holocron]], Vima Sunrider recollected her time with Qel-Droma and how despite his [[Sever Force/Legends|inability]] to touch [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], he was able to successfully instruct her in the creation of her own lightsaber.<ref name="JVS">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TotJRedemption5-Textless-EC.png|thumb|right|200px|Vima Sunrider and her wrongly-colored lightsaber, from the cover of ''[[Tales of the Jedi – Redemption 5|Master]]'', the fifth issue of ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Redemption]]''.]]
Vima Sunrider's lightsaber first appeared in ''[[Tales of the Jedi – Redemption 4]]'' the fourth issue in the [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Redemption|''Redemption'']] story arc of the [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (comic series)|''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] series. The issue was written by [[Kevin J. Anderson]], penciled by [[Chris Gossett]], and released by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="R4" /> on [[October 28]], [[1998]].<ref name="DarkHorse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/97-388/Star-Wars-Tales-of-the-Jedi---Redemption-4-of-5|text=Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi - Redemption 4}}</ref> The scene in which the lightsaber is created, as well as subsequent scenes in which it is depicted, were part of months of close collaboration between Gossett and writer Anderson, who worked hand-in-hand with the intention of producing a very emotional storyline throughout the entire ''Redemption'' arc.<ref name="ICG">[[Wookieepedia:Interview/Christian Gossett|Interview with Christian Gossett]]</ref>

The cover of the arc's [[Tales of the Jedi – Redemption 5|fifth issue]], drawn by [[Igor Kordey]], incorrectly portrays Vima Sunrider's lightsaber with a vivid magenta blade.<ref name="R5" /> [[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']], which includes an [[in-universe]] mention of the lightsaber made by Sunrider, also shows an image of her and her weapon, again drawn incorrectly, now with a blue blade by [[Tommy Lee Edwards]].<ref name="JVS" />
